# T-3: Add plugin registry

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Resolve enabled plugin contributions for presets, commands, skills, config schema/defaults, and DataSource static meta.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Only plugin.packages entries are loaded as active contributions.
- Later enabled packages override earlier contribution providers.
- Core built-in commands cannot be overridden.
- plugin.json contribution entries define commands, presets, skills, config schema/defaults, and DataSource static meta with required path/key fields.

## Implementation Notes
Registry should expose final providers for plugin list --json and hide disabled runtime files.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for contribution order, disabled plugin exclusion, and built-in command collision.
